description: Sicheres Radverkehrsnetz und Bike&Ride-Erreichbarkeitsklassen is a dataset listed in data.gv.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mobilitydata.gv.at. The Bike&Ride accessibility classes represent the accessibility of public transport stops on the basis of a safe cycling network by bicycle or e-bike. This A safe cycling network is based on the GIP and takes into account a dedicated cycling infrastructure. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Safe cycling network and Bike&Ride accessibility classes" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include sicheres Radverkehrsnetz, Bike and Ride Erreichbarkeitsklassen, Radverkehr, GIP, Fahrrad. The listing shows 1 download or service links in SHP. The listing shows 2024-08-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gv-at.
